name: DM-NeRF
definition: A pipeline that simultaneously reconstructs continuous 3D scene geometry, decomposes all individual objects in 3D space, and supports flexible object shape manipulation (translation, rotation, size adjustment, deformation) from 2D images only.
summary: DM-NeRF reconstructs 3D scenes and manipulates individual objects from 2D images by introducing an object field that predicts unique codes for every point, enabling instance-level decomposition without explicit mesh extraction.
